name: Clay
tagline: Matte clay 3D renders — pastel objects, soft studio light
technique: Matte clay / plasticine 3D render: soft rounded objects with fingerprint-free matte surfaces, pastel mint, peach and sky with one coral accent, soft studio lighting and gentle ambient occlusion.
avoid: legal and finance that must look sober

plates.accept: Clay objects on the right, empty left; matte, pastel; no text.
Clay laptop with chart; no text on the screen.
Clay handshake; plausible simplified hands; no text.
One row of clay objects; nothing else; no text.
One clay envelope on flat pure green; no shadow on the background.
One clay rocket on flat pure green.
One clay bar chart on flat pure green.

generate.base: A matte clay 3D render of {subject}: soft rounded plasticine surfaces, pastel mint, peach and sky colors with one coral accent, soft studio lighting, gentle ambient occlusion. No faces.
generate.spot: A matte clay 3D render of {subject} as a single chunky toy-like object in pastel peach, mint and sky with one coral accent, soft rounded plasticine surfaces, soft studio lighting, floating with no floor and no cast shadow.
generate.rules: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature anywhere in the image.
